text: The applications propose to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law to permit a 14-storey mixed-use building consisting of 175 dwelling units, 229.47 square metres of retail space and 3158.21 square metres of community space to be used by the Learning Enrichment Foundation. The proposed development contains 175 residential units, of which 20 units will be rental replacement units, with a total gross floor area of 13,571.29 square metres resulting in a density (FSI) of 6.89 times the area of the lot. The proposal also includes a Tenant Relocation and Assistance Plan that addresses the right for eligible tenants to return to a replacement rental dwelling unit at similar rents and financial compensation to lessen hardship.
